title: Jaeger's 4-flow and 8-flow theorems and Seymour's 6-flow theorem
summary: A Lean 4 / Mathlib formalization of Jaeger's 4-flow theorem: every finite 4-edge-connected simple graph has a nowhere-zero integer 4-flow, i.e. an antisymmetric function on darts with values in {±1, ±2, ±3} that is conserved at every vertex. Also proved: a graph with two edge-disjoint spanning trees has its edges covered by two even subgraphs (a nowhere-zero ℤ₂ × ℤ₂-flow) and has a nowhere-zero integer 4-flow.
